* [1224] 额度耗尽结构化识别 + 异常请求原文落盘 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1400
* [1225] 修复工具卡片超宽输出不折行被截断吞字的问题 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1401
* [1223] 修复非法 UTF-8 字节导致 pi bash 工具输出丢失 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1402

* [1220] gf pi 配置目录统一为 ~/.gf/agent，移除 ~/.pi/agent 回退；会话与扩展仍归属 ~/.pi/agent by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1405
* [1229] 修复 gf pi Ctrl+T 崩溃退出与状态提示问题 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1406
* [1224] minimax-cn 识别 Token Plan 五小时额度耗尽并停止重试；移除未实际使用的 minimax 国际版 provider by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1408

* [1230] 修复 Windows fs-watch 启动固定延迟 2 秒的问题 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1410
* [1224] google 识别月消费上限额度耗尽并停止重试 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1411
* [1231] gf pi 启动 git 探测改为纯文件读取，消除两次子进程开销 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1412
* [1232] 重新设计 bin/gf pi 的 provider 与模型配置（三层文件 + 白名单 + provider 级代理） by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1413
* [1234] 修复 gf pi /model 切换后 multikey 不生效 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1414
* [1233] 新增 gf pi config：ranger 风格三列只读配置浏览 TUI by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1415
* [1233] gf pi config：v 查看、space 启停、Enter 设默认，并接入 /config by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1416
* [1236] 修复 busy 时 steering 插话消息不进入模型上下文 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1417
* [1235] gf pi 对齐上游思考级别解析：默认 medium、per-model 覆盖与按模型能力收敛 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/goldfish/pull/1418
